topBullNews.title: Apple, Taiwan Semi Lead Five Stocks Near Buy Points
topBullNews.summary: Apple, which just unveiled its first foldable iPhone and two other new models that go on sale this week, and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing, which makes the chips that power them, lead this weekend's watch list of five top stocks near buy points.  Joining AAPL and TSM are cloud-based communications software platform Twilio and two healthcare plays.  Oscar Health is the No. 2 health insurer based on Affordable Care Act exchange membership.
